posts.body: Just wondering if anyone can recommend which baby clubs (Boots, Bounty, Johnsons etc) it is worth signing up for?
posts.body_with_quotes: Just wondering if anyone can recommend which baby clubs (Boots, Bounty, Johnsons etc) it is worth signing up for?

posts.body:
While I like the free bounty packs the only club i would recommend is the Boots one purely for the free changing bag which has lasted me 2 years so far!

Getting another one soon

posts.body:
Also Emma's diary, you get packs with that too 

I joined them all, we got some free toys, spoons, baby rice etc. There is a link somewhere for all the ones to join. We've had lots of vouchers too, mostly no use to use but we've used some if it's something we would be getting anyway.

WG x
